name: Flask & Barrel
detailed_description:
As a young aspiring Brew Master, desperate to leave home, you get a one way ticket to the bustling city of Porthaven. Drawn in by a real estate listing for a run-down micro-brewery, you take on crippling debt to carve out a name for yourself in the big city, and ferment your legacy. Craft, cook, bubble, and brew your way out of this financial hole you’ve dug, building personal and professional relationships on your way to the grand title of Brew Master.

Key Features

Brewing

Collect and craft ingredients to combine in a dynamic array of brewing machines to keep the shelves stocked and the cash rolling in.

Building

Build and buy new machines and accessories to transform the brewery from a run-down shack into a large scale operation. Automate and optimize your recipes to increase profits and pay back the bank! Customize and decorate to make the shop and brewery your own!

Shopkeeping

Interact with customers, making sales, delivering orders, and going the extra mile to keep them happy! Keep the shelves full and the doors open, and you’ll be out of this mess in no time!
